scope.population: 10455129 taker fills over 3 windows; every cell repeated at each of [60, 10] seconds and each fill floor in [50, 100], per coin and pooled, with the out-of-sample split by wallet over 5 folds
scope.window: windows present [202508, 202510, 202512] of [202508, 202510, 202512] requested, ten days each, split per period into an early and a late half over its own resolved days

declared_not_confirmed.note: settings.py declares these; this run did not state what it used, so they are the declaration and not a property of this artifact

object: PANEL-ANALYZE - December core chain re-run per period + pooled; reproduction reported PER HORIZON (10s is the headline and the robust common thread; the 60s companion window attenuates in the October crash regime)

scope.data_source: node_fills_by_block ONLY (trade-print markout, native ns block_time). No l2Book / book-mid in this panel (a documented follow-on).
scope.early_late_split: per period, first ceil(n/2) distinct resolved days = EARLY, remainder = LATE (generalises the ks2 first-half/second-half split so each month's window splits on its own day range).
scope.comparator_scope: TRADE-TAPE-ONLY anonymous metrics (VPIN bulk-volume classification, rolling signed-flow imbalance, mean size, trade intensity); identical to the December i3 comparator family. NO order book.
scope.headline_question: Does the non-recoverability result (history FE adds OOS lift over the anonymous trade tape, placebo kills it) REPRODUCE across ALL THREE months, not just December?

family.method: sort ascending, q_(i) = p_(i) * m / i, running minimum from the largest p downward, clipped to 1; NaN p-values are carried through and excluded from the family size
family.family: panel non-recoverability placebo p-values across (period x coin x horizon x K), per-coin and pooled
family.threshold_meaning: the p-value cutoff actually applied: the largest rank k with p_(k) <= k*alpha/m, times alpha/m. With no rejection it is the rank-one bar the best cell failed
family.q_note: the q-values are on the cells, under bh_qvalue; this block holds the procedure, the family and the cutoff applied to them

headline.question: Does the non-recoverability result reproduce across all resolved months (Aug / Oct / Dec 2025) - and at WHICH horizon?
headline.bh_family_scope: PANEL-WIDE: one Benjamini-Hochberg family over all tested cells (period x coin x horizon x K); m = 48 tested cells (not a per-period family).

october_or_worst_regime_attenuation.flag: ATTENUATION at the 60s horizon in period 202510: only 1 of 8 60s cell(s) carry positive incremental R^2 AND survive BH-FDR (BTC K=50 at incremental R^2 +0.0064); 5 60s cell(s) have NEGATIVE incremental R^2 (incl. pooled / other coins); and the aggregate 60s markout for this period is NEGATIVE for every coin (makers PROFITED on net, i.e. the crash flow was NOT adverse to the maker at this horizon).

headline.weak_rule_note: reproduces_all_periods_weak_rule = at least one positive-lift cell survives BH-FDR in every period. This is TRUE here but is the weak read: it does not distinguish horizons. Use robust_horizon_s and october_or_worst_regime_attenuation for the honest statement.
headline.verdict: REPRODUCES AT THE 10s HORIZON IN EVERY RESOLVED MONTH (the robust common thread: a positive-incremental-lift 10s cell survives the panel-wide BH-FDR in each of 202508, 202510, 202512; the pre-registered pooled / 10s / K=50 cell is the through-line). Per-period survivor counts across the full cell family: 202508 = 13/16; 202510 = 5/16; 202512 = 13/16. BUT THE 60s HORIZON IS NOT ROBUST ACROSS REGIMES - it attenuates sharply in period 202510: ATTENUATION at the 60s horizon in period 202510: only 1 of 8 60s cell(s) carry positive incremental R^2 AND survive BH-FDR (BTC K=50 at incremental R^2 +0.0064); 5 60s cell(s) have NEGATIVE incremental R^2 (incl. pooled / other coins); and the aggregate 60s markout for this period is NEGATIVE for every coin (makers PROFITED on net, i.e. the crash flow was NOT adverse to the maker at this horizon). A single trivial cell technically surviving BH-FDR does NOT make this horizon reproduce in that regime. Do NOT report a flat 'reproduces in every month' headline: that is true only under the weak rule that ANY single positive-lift cell survives per period, and it masks this horizon split.
